statement: Over a field k of characteristic zero, the quadratically enriched count of degree-2 rational plane curves through 5 general k-rational points is ⟨1⟩ in GW(k).

source.location: Section 8.2 and Table 1, printed pages 56–57; characteristic-zero setup in Section 1.2.1
source.version: arXiv:2307.01936v2 (28 February 2026), primary PDF inspected 4 November 2026

scope: Degree-2 irreducible rational plane curves with 5 general k-rational point conditions, in characteristic zero.
notes: The source permits more general prescribed residue-field extensions; the displayed specialization is sufficient for this problem. The unique solution is smooth and its local arithmetic mass is ⟨1⟩.
